title: Adam under Generalized Smoothness with Second-Moment-Type Stochastic Gradients
abstract: arXiv:2609.37787v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Adam is widely observed to remain stable even when the objective deviates significantly from global smoothness. Under the generalized smoothness framework, however, existing analyses rely on strong tail assumptions on the stochastic gradients, such as almost-sure boundedness or sub-Gaussianity. Whether Adam converges on generalized smooth objectives under only second moment information on the stochastic gradients, without such concentration assumptions, was identified as an important open direction by Li et al. (2023). This paper gives an affirmative answer under fairly general conditions: such tail assumptions are not necessary. Building on the Adam self-normalization framework of Jin et al. (2026), developed for classical smoothness and bounded variance, we extend the stopping-time and de-preconditioning strategy to the $L_0$-$L_p$ generalized smoothness condition and a generalized second moment ABC condition. translated_title: 基于二阶矩型随机梯度的广义平滑条件下的Adam算法
translated_abstract: 人们广泛观察到，即使目标函数明显偏离全局平滑性，Adam仍能保持稳定。然而在广义平滑框架下，现有分析依赖于对随机梯度的强尾部假设，例如几乎处处有界或次高斯性。仅利用随机梯度的二阶矩信息、无需此类集中性假设时，Adam是否能在广义平滑目标上收敛，被Li等人（2023）确定为一个重要的开放性问题。本文在相当一般的条件下给出了肯定的答案：此类尾部假设并非必要。基于Jin等人（2026）针对经典平滑和有界方差情形提出的Adam自归一化框架，我们将停止时间与去预条件化策略扩展到 $L_0$-$L_p$ 广义平滑条件和广义二阶矩ABC条件。即使当随机——（摘要至此截断）
tldr: 本文证明在仅假设随机梯度满足广义二阶矩条件的情况下，Adam即可在 $L_0$-$L_p$ 广义平滑目标上收敛，无需几乎处处有界或次高斯等尾部假设，从而解决了Li等人（2023）提出的开放性问题。
en_tdlr: This paper proves that Adam converges on $L_0$-$L_p$ generalized smooth objectives assuming only a generalized second-moment condition on the stochastic gradients—without tail assumptions such as almost-sure boundedness or sub-Gaussianity—thereby resolving an open question raised by Li et al. (2023).
